_comment: Codex-native marketplace catalog. When this repository (or a checkout of it) is added with `codex plugin marketplace add`, Codex reads THIS file and ignores .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (verified on codex-cli 0.142.5). Exactly one entry: Codex requires plugins[].name to match the .codex-plugin/plugin.json name at the entry's source, and this repo root carries one manifest, so the Claude bundle names (hse-all, hse-core, ...) must never be listed here. Guarded by scripts/tests/test_codex_marketplace_catalog.py.
